ordinals.title: v16a: Hippocampus neural retrieval, 36 system bugfixes, pre-release notice
ordinals.finding: Hippocampus retrieval gained cache/thread/training/dedup fixes, async node refresh and consolidation training; chat safety/output pipelines added input-side hard filters, identity/tool/memory/hardware cleanup, content-sensitive reward channels, stale-hypothesis confidence decay and a pre-release warning that the missing custom LoRA materially affected personality/safety/tool behavior. Source-reported performance/fix counts are not independently reproduced.

ordinals.title: Fix PTT button visibility + chat message alignment
ordinals.finding: PTT control had been rendered before its DOM container existed; initialization moved to page mount. Useful lifecycle ordering detail only.

ordinals.title: Move PTT button from navbar into chat input bubble
Voice: remove conversation mode, improve PTT
ordinals.finding: Continuous conversation/listening mode was removed in favor of explicit push-to-talk after false-trigger/reliability concerns; short accidental captures were rejected and microphone warm-state improved latency. For noisy/high-authority sensors, explicit user actuation plus a minimum evidence window can dominate autonomous activation.

ordinals.title: Fix vision UI: Describe/Transcribe bubble, strip tool tags from stream, improve formatting
ordinals.finding: Vision was split into explicit Describe versus Transcribe modes: generative interpretation versus OCR-only extraction. Consciousness/chat presentation stripped tool/directive/recent-life/control material before display. These are distinct evidence modes and internal control metadata should not bleed into user-visible cognition.

ordinals.title: FrankEye: Describe/Transcribe bubble + fix tool tag stripping order
ordinals.finding: Image upload gained a mode field for OCR-only versus full description. A stale browser-cached api.js forced an inline fetch workaround, demonstrating that client static-asset caching can create API-contract/version divergence without cache busting or compatibility handling.

ordinals.title: Add FrankEye vision to WebUI: drag & drop, upload button, auto-analyze
ordinals.finding: Tool tags had been stripped in response cleaning before the tool dispatcher saw them, blocking all tool execution; stripping was moved after dispatch. This is direct evidence that presentation sanitization must follow structured tool parsing/authority/execution, not precede it.

ordinals.title: Remove benchmark section from README
ordinals.finding: A large benchmark block was removed from the front page while benchmark data remained elsewhere. Front-page omission is a presentation decision, not validation or invalidation of the underlying metrics; evidence status must be tracked separately from prominence.

ordinals.title: Reposition README: agent system, not chatbot
ordinals.finding: README explicitly clarified that bio-inspired subsystem names are engineering metaphors rather than sentience claims, while also promoting architecture/benchmark/funding claims. Mechanistic naming and phenomenal interpretation were therefore explicitly separated in source lineage.

ordinals.title: V15 evaluation: fix 26 bugs (9 SB + 17 deep-log analysis)
ordinals.finding: Added broad safety/output/tool guards, capped stray tool bursts, fixed energy recalibration deadlock and multiple utility bugs. Critically, the same early tool-tag stripping introduced here was later corrected at k54 because it blocked tool dispatch, showing that safety/presentation filters can impair legitimate execution if phase ordering is wrong. Counts/rates remain source-reported.

ordinals.title: Deep Agents integration: write_plan, scratchpad, tool-set filtering
ordinals.finding: Agent loop added plan refresh, offloading large outputs to scratchpad, goal-based tool filtering and fallback parsing for LoRA tool tags to reduce small-model drift/confusion. Although described as session-scoped, the shown scratchpad is a module-global dictionary without session namespacing, so concurrent/session isolation requires verification rather than assumption.

ordinals.title: Fix: persistant typo in repo subtitle, rename Research Papers to Technical Notes
ordinals.finding: Repository relabeled its papers as Technical Notes & Design Documents and explicitly stated they were not peer reviewed. Research synthesis must preserve that evidence class instead of promoting repository-authored design notes into peer-reviewed literature.

ordinals.title: Add Telegram + WhatsApp messaging bridges with Web UI setup
ordinals.finding: Telegram/WhatsApp external ingress gained per-user sessions and optional whitelists, but empty whitelist meant allow-all. Because bridged text reaches Frank's chat/tool surface, remote ingress should have explicit authentication/capability scope and fail-closed defaults rather than treating absence of a whitelist as public access.

ordinals.title: Remove Genesis entirely from ARCHITECTURE.md — 125 lines of dead documentation
ordinals.finding: Detailed deprecated Genesis architecture was removed and replaced with a concise removed/inactive note because preserved dead documentation confused current users. Historical details belong in versioned provenance/history, while current architecture docs should distinguish inactive code from active topology.

ordinals.title: Fix outdated docs: ARCHITECTURE.md + HOW_IT_WORKS.md aligned with current system
ordinals.finding: Architecture/how-it-works were reconciled from multi-model/overlay/AURA/Genesis/Ollama/Whisper-GPU topology to single Qwen 3B/WebUI/Swarm/FrankEye/CPU-voice topology. This reinforces explicit documentation epochs and active-versus-historical topology separation.

negative_results_preserved: Tool-tag sanitization executed before dispatch and blocked all legitimate tools until ordering was corrected.
Continuous voice/conversation mode was removed in favor of PTT because explicit actuation was judged cleaner and less prone to false triggers.
Browser caching caused a stale client API dependency during image-upload evolution.
Internal tool/directive/recent-life metadata leaked into visible streams until presentation cleaning was added.
A supposedly session-scoped agent scratchpad was represented in code by a module-global dictionary and requires isolation verification.
Remote messaging bridge access control was optional and empty whitelist meant allow-all.
Dead Genesis architecture remained in current docs long enough to confuse users and had to be removed.
Current architecture docs repeatedly lagged model/interface/service topology and required reconciliation.
measurement_boundary: All source-reported parameter counts, hot-path latency spikes, benchmark values, fix totals, safety-test counts and performance claims are historical source claims unless independently reproduced. This pass records exact code/diff lineage and negative-result evidence only.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual-dedup audit against HISTORICAL_EARNED_WORK was performed.
